description: DBEngine.CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 32) with dbVersion 32 in a MDB-named file: reads Version and CollatingOrder, then, if created, builds T(ID, K TEXT(255), G) with a 40-value sample of the corpus, index IX_K after the rows, reads the SQL ORDER BY K and IX_K traversal, closes and keeps the file image. Asks whether this dbVersion is obtainable, and which identifier/version the file carries.
